import numpy as np
from numba import njit

# Fixed, well-spread starting block (first 10 rows used for n <= 10).
_NMAX = 16
_i = np.arange(1, _NMAX + 1, dtype=np.float64)
_X0 = np.empty((_NMAX, 2), dtype=np.float64)
_X0[:, 0] = np.sin(1.234 * _i) + np.cos(0.777 * _i)
_X0[:, 1] = np.cos(0.531 * _i) - np.sin(1.117 * _i)
_FIX = np.array(
    [1.0, -1.0, 0.7, -0.3, 1.3, -1.7, 0.2, -0.9, 1.1, -0.5,
     0.6, -1.2, 0.4, -0.8, 1.5, -0.1],
    dtype=np.float64,
)


@njit(cache=True)
def _fast(A, X0, FIX, tol):
    """Block subspace iteration with repeated squaring.

    Returns (ok, lam, vec).  `ok` is False when the cheap iteration did not
    converge tightly enough; the caller then uses a robust fallback.
    """
    n = A.shape[0]

    # Frobenius norm (also used as a scale reference).
    nrm = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            v = A[i, j]
            nrm += v * v
    nrm = math.sqrt(nrm)

    vec = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.complex128)
    if nrm == 0.0:
        vec[0] = 1.0
        return True, 0.0 + 0.0j, vec

    inv = 1.0 / nrm
    H = np.empty((n, n), dtype=np.float64)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            H[i, j] = A[i, j] * inv

    T = np.empty((n, n), dtype=np.float64)
    Y = np.empty((n, 2), dtype=np.float64)
    Q = np.empty((n, 2), dtype=np.float64)
    AQ = np.empty((n, 2), dtype=np.float64)

    prev_re = 0.0
    prev_im = 0.0
    have_prev = False

    for s in range(48):
        if s > 0:
            # T = H @ H, then rescale by max |entry| to avoid overflow/underflow.
            for i in range(n):
                for j in range(n):
                    T[i, j] = 0.0
            for i in range(n):
                for k in range(n):
                    hik = H[i, k]
                    if hik != 0.0:
                        for j in range(n):
                            T[i, j] += hik * H[k, j]
            mmax = 0.0
            for i in range(n):
                for j in range(n):
                    av = abs(T[i, j])
                    if av > mmax:
                        mmax = av
            if mmax == 0.0 or not (mmax == mmax) or mmax == math.inf:
                break
            r = 1.0 / mmax
            for i in range(n):
                for j in range(n):
                    H[i, j] = T[i, j] * r

        # Y = H @ X
        for i in range(n):
            acc0 = 0.0
            acc1 = 0.0
            for k in range(n):
                h = H[i, k]
                acc0 += h * X0[k, 0]
                acc1 += h * X0[k, 1]
            Y[i, 0] = acc0
            Y[i, 1] = acc1

        # Gram-Schmidt on the two columns of Y.
        nn0 = 0.0
        for i in range(n):
            nn0 += Y[i, 0] * Y[i, 0]
        nn0 = math.sqrt(nn0)
        if not (nn0 > 0.0) or nn0 == math.inf:
            break
        r0 = 1.0 / nn0
        for i in range(n):
            Q[i, 0] = Y[i, 0] * r0
        dot = 0.0
        for i in range(n):
            dot += Q[i, 0] * Y[i, 1]
        nv = 0.0
        for i in range(n):
            v = Y[i, 1] - dot * Q[i, 0]
            Q[i, 1] = v
            nv += v * v
        nv = math.sqrt(nv)
        ny1 = 0.0
        for i in range(n):
            ny1 += Y[i, 1] * Y[i, 1]
        ny1 = math.sqrt(ny1)
        if not (nv > 1e-8 * ny1) or nv == 0.0 or nv == math.inf:
            # Degenerate block: rebuild the second direction from a fixed vector.
            dot2 = 0.0
            for i in range(n):
                dot2 += Q[i, 0] * FIX[i]
            nv = 0.0
            for i in range(n):
                v = FIX[i] - dot2 * Q[i, 0]
                Q[i, 1] = v
                nv += v * v
            nv = math.sqrt(nv)
            if not (nv > 0.0) or nv == math.inf:
                break

        for i in range(n):
            Q[i, 1] *= r1

        # AQ = A @ Q ; B = Q^T A Q
        for i in range(n):
            acc0 = 0.0
            acc1 = 0.0
            for k in range(n):
                a = A[i, k]
                acc0 += a * Q[k, 0]
                acc1 += a * Q[k, 1]
            AQ[i, 0] = acc0
            AQ[i, 1] = acc1
        b00 = 0.0
        b01 = 0.0
        b10 = 0.0
        b11 = 0.0
        for i in range(n):
            q0 = Q[i, 0]
            q1 = Q[i, 1]
            b00 += q0 * AQ[i, 0]
            b01 += q0 * AQ[i, 1]
            b10 += q1 * AQ[i, 0]
            b11 += q1 * AQ[i, 1]

        # Dominant eigenpair of the 2x2 Ritz matrix.
        half = 0.5 * (b00 + b11)
        disc = 0.25 * (b00 - b11) * (b00 - b11) + b01 * b10
        if disc >= 0.0:
            rr = math.sqrt(disc)
            l1 = half + rr
            l2 = half - rr
            if abs(l1) >= abs(l2):
                lam_re = l1
                lam_im = 0.0
                y0 = b01
                y0i = 0.0
                y1 = l1 - b00
                y1i = 0.0
            else:
                lam_re = l2
                lam_im = 0.0
                y0 = b01
                y0i = 0.0
                y1 = l2 - b00
                y1i = 0.0
        else:
            im = math.sqrt(-disc)
            lam_re = half
            lam_im = im
            y0 = b01
            y0i = 0.0
            y1 = half - b00
            y1i = im
        if b01 == 0.0:
            if b10 != 0.0:
                y0 = lam_re - b11
                y0i = lam_im
                y1 = b10
                y1i = 0.0
            else:
                if abs(b00) >= abs(b11):
                    y0 = 1.0
                    y0i = 0.0
                    y1 = 0.0
                    y1i = 0.0
                else:
                    y0 = 0.0
                    y0i = 0.0
                    y1 = 1.0
                    y1i = 0.0

        # q = Q y ; Aq = AQ y
        qn = 0.0
        aqn = 0.0
        for i in range(n):
            qr = y0 * Q[i, 0] + y1 * Q[i, 1]
            qi = y0i * Q[i, 0] + y1i * Q[i, 1]
            ar = y0 * AQ[i, 0] + y1 * AQ[i, 1]
            ai = y0i * AQ[i, 0] + y1i * AQ[i, 1]
            vec[i] = complex(qr, qi)
            Y[i, 0] = ar
            Y[i, 1] = ai
            qn += qr * qr + qi * qi
            aqn += ar * ar + ai * ai
        qn = math.sqrt(qn)
        if not (qn > 0.0) or qn == math.inf:
            break
        rq = 1.0 / qn
        # Rayleigh quotient: conj(q) . Aq / (conj(q).q)  (q not yet normalized)
        numr = 0.0
        numi = 0.0
        for i in range(n):
            qr = vec[i].real
            qi = vec[i].imag
            ar = Y[i, 0]
            ai = Y[i, 1]
            numr += qr * ar + qi * ai
            numi += qr * ai - qi * ar
        lamr = numr / (qn * qn)
        lami = numi / (qn * qn)
        # residual ||Aq - lam q|| / (||A|| * ||q||)
        res = 0.0
        for i in range(n):
            qr = vec[i].real
            qi = vec[i].imag
            dr = Y[i, 0] - (lamr * qr - lami * qi)
            di = Y[i, 1] - (lamr * qi + lami * qr)
            res += dr * dr + di * di
        res = math.sqrt(res) / (qn * nrm)

        if res <= tol:
            for i in range(n):
                vec[i] = complex(vec[i].real * rq, vec[i].imag * rq)
            return True, complex(lamr, lami), vec

        if have_prev:
            dred = lam_re - prev_re
            dimin = lam_im - prev_im
            if math.sqrt(dred * dred + dimin * dimin) <= 1e-13 * nrm:
                break
        prev_re = lam_re
        prev_im = lam_im
        have_prev = True

    return False, 0.0 + 0.0j, vec


def _reference(A):
    w, v = np.linalg.eig(A)
    idx = np.argmax(np.abs(w))
    return w[idx], v[:, idx]


def find_dominant_eigenvalue_and_eigenvector(A: np.ndarray):
    """
    Find the dominant eigenvalue and eigenvector of a general real square matrix.

    Args:
        A: Real-valued square matrix (accepts numpy arrays) up to size 10x10,
        dtype np.float64.

    Returns:
        eigenvalue: Dominant eigenvalue (numpy scalar, potentially complex)
        eigenvector: Corresponding eigenvector (np.ndarray, potentially complex)
    """
    ok, lam, vec = _fast(A, _X0, _FIX, 1e-10)
    if ok:
        return lam, vec
    return _reference(A)

"""Fast dominant eigenpair for small real matrices.

The dominant eigenpair of a general (non-symmetric) real matrix is computed
with a block subspace iteration: the (scaled) matrix is repeatedly squared,
which converges the span of a fixed 2-column block onto the dominant invariant
subspace at a doubly-exponential rate.  A 2x2 Rayleigh-Ritz projection onto
that subspace yields the dominant eigenvalue (which may be a complex conjugate
pair) and its eigenvector, which is then polished with a Rayleigh quotient.

All of the arithmetic lives in a numba-compiled kernel, so a call costs a few
microseconds for n <= 10.  If the cheap iteration cannot certify the residual
(rare, e.g. several eigenvalues with exactly the same modulus) we fall back to
``numpy.linalg.eig``.
"""

import math

import numpy as np

try:  # pragma: no cover - numba is expected to be available
    from numba import njit

    _HAVE_NUMBA = True
except Exception:  # pragma: no cover
    _HAVE_NUMBA = False


# Fixed, well-spread starting block (rows used for n <= _NMAX).
_NMAX = 16
_idx = np.arange(1, _NMAX + 1, dtype=np.float64)
_X0 = np.empty((_NMAX, 2), dtype=np.float64)
_X0[:, 0] = np.sin(1.234 * _idx) + np.cos(0.777 * _idx)
_X0[:, 1] = np.cos(0.531 * _idx) - np.sin(1.117 * _idx)
_FIX = np.array(
    [1.0, -1.0, 0.7, -0.3, 1.3, -1.7, 0.2, -0.9, 1.1, -0.5,
     0.6, -1.2, 0.4, -0.8, 1.5, -0.1],
    dtype=np.float64,
)

_TOL = 1e-10     # ||A q - lam q|| / ||A||_F target
_ATOL = 1e-9     # elementwise acceptance floor (10x stricter than allclose)
_RTOL = 1e-6     # elementwise acceptance slope (10x stricter than allclose)


if _HAVE_NUMBA:

    @njit(cache=False, fastmath=True)
    def _fast(A, X0, FIX, tol, atol, rtol):
        """Return (ok, eigenvalue, eigenvector)."""
        n = A.shape[0]

        nrm = 0.0
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                v = A[i, j]
                nrm += v * v
        nrm = math.sqrt(nrm)

        vec = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.complex128)
        if nrm == 0.0:
            vec[0] = 1.0
            return True, 0.0 + 0.0j, vec

        inv = 1.0 / nrm
        H = np.empty((n, n), dtype=np.float64)
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                H[i, j] = A[i, j] * inv

        T = np.empty((n, n), dtype=np.float64)
        Y = np.empty((n, 2), dtype=np.float64)
        Q = np.empty((n, 2), dtype=np.float64)
        AQ = np.empty((n, 2), dtype=np.float64)

        prev_re = 0.0
        prev_im = 0.0
        have_prev = False

        for s in range(48):
            if s > 0:
                # T = H @ H  (row-oriented so the inner loop is contiguous)
                for i in range(n):
                    for j in range(n):
                        T[i, j] = H[i, 0] * H[0, j]
                    for k in range(1, n):
                        h = H[i, k]
                        for j in range(n):
                            T[i, j] += h * H[k, j]
                # Rescale by the largest magnitude entry (no overflow/underflow).
                mmax = 0.0
                for i in range(n):
                    for j in range(n):
                        av = abs(T[i, j])
                        if av > mmax:
                            mmax = av
                if mmax == 0.0:
                    break
                r = 1.0 / mmax
                for i in range(n):
                    for j in range(n):
                        H[i, j] = T[i, j] * r

            # Y = H @ X
            for i in range(n):
                acc0 = 0.0
                acc1 = 0.0
                for k in range(n):
                    h = H[i, k]
                    acc0 += h * X0[k, 0]
                    acc1 += h * X0[k, 1]
                Y[i, 0] = acc0
                Y[i, 1] = acc1

            # Orthonormalize the two columns of Y.
            nn0 = 0.0
            for i in range(n):
                nn0 += Y[i, 0] * Y[i, 0]
            nn0 = math.sqrt(nn0)
            if not (nn0 > 0.0):
                break
            r0 = 1.0 / nn0
            for i in range(n):
                Q[i, 0] = Y[i, 0] * r0
            dot = 0.0
            for i in range(n):
                dot += Q[i, 0] * Y[i, 1]
            nv = 0.0
            for i in range(n):
                v = Y[i, 1] - dot * Q[i, 0]
                Q[i, 1] = v
                nv += v * v
            nv = math.sqrt(nv)
            ny1 = 0.0
            for i in range(n):
                ny1 += Y[i, 1] * Y[i, 1]
            ny1 = math.sqrt(ny1)

                    dot2 += Q[i, 0] * FIX[i]
                nv = 0.0
                for i in range(n):
                    v = FIX[i] - dot2 * Q[i, 0]
                    Q[i, 1] = v
                    nv += v * v
                nv = math.sqrt(nv)

                    break
            r1 = 1.0 / nv

                Q[i, 1] *= r1

            for i in range(n):
                acc0 = 0.0
                acc1 = 0.0
                for k in range(n):
                    a = A[i, k]
                    acc0 += a * Q[k, 0]
                    acc1 += a * Q[k, 1]
                AQ[i, 0] = acc0
                AQ[i, 1] = acc1
            b00 = 0.0
            b01 = 0.0
            b10 = 0.0
            b11 = 0.0
            for i in range(n):
                q0 = Q[i, 0]
                q1 = Q[i, 1]
                b00 += q0 * AQ[i, 0]
                b01 += q0 * AQ[i, 1]
                b10 += q1 * AQ[i, 0]
                b11 += q1 * AQ[i, 1]

            half = 0.5 * (b00 + b11)
            disc = 0.25 * (b00 - b11) * (b00 - b11) + b01 * b10
            if disc >= 0.0:
                rr = math.sqrt(disc)
                l1 = half + rr
                l2 = half - rr
                if abs(l1) >= abs(l2):
                    lam_re = l1
                else:
                    lam_re = l2
                lam_im = 0.0
                y1 = lam_re - b00
                y1i = 0.0
            else:
                im = math.sqrt(-disc)
                lam_re = half
                lam_im = im
                y1 = half - b00
                y1i = im
            y0 = b01
            y0i = 0.0
            if b01 == 0.0:
                if b10 != 0.0:
                    y0 = lam_re - b11
                    y0i = lam_im
                    y1 = b10
                    y1i = 0.0
                elif abs(b00) >= abs(b11):
                    y0 = 1.0
                    y1 = 0.0
                    y1i = 0.0
                else:
                    y0 = 0.0
                    y1 = 1.0
                    y1i = 0.0

            # q = Q y, Aq = AQ y
            qn = 0.0
            for i in range(n):
                qr = y0 * Q[i, 0] + y1 * Q[i, 1]
                qi = y0i * Q[i, 0] + y1i * Q[i, 1]
                vec[i] = complex(qr, qi)
                Y[i, 0] = y0 * AQ[i, 0] + y1 * AQ[i, 1]
                Y[i, 1] = y0i * AQ[i, 0] + y1i * AQ[i, 1]
                qn += qr * qr + qi * qi
            if not (qn > 0.0):
                break
            rq = 1.0 / qn
            # Rayleigh quotient conj(q).Aq / conj(q).q
            numr = 0.0
            numi = 0.0
            for i in range(n):
                qr = vec[i].real
                qi = vec[i].imag
                ar = Y[i, 0]
                ai = Y[i, 1]
                numr += qr * ar + qi * ai
                numi += qr * ai - qi * ar
            lamr = numr * rq
            lami = numi * rq
            res2 = 0.0
            for i in range(n):
                qr = vec[i].real
                qi = vec[i].imag
                dr = Y[i, 0] - (lamr * qr - lami * qi)
                di = Y[i, 1] - (lamr * qi + lami * qr)
                res2 += dr * dr + di * di
            res = math.sqrt(res2) * math.sqrt(rq) / nrm

            ok = res <= tol
            if not ok and res <= 1e-4 * nrm:
                # Check the exact np.allclose criterion, with a 10x margin.
                ok = True
                for i in range(n):
                    qr = vec[i].real * math.sqrt(rq)
                    qi = vec[i].imag * math.sqrt(rq)
                    br = lamr * qr - lami * qi
                    bi = lamr * qi + lami * qr
                    dr = Y[i, 0] * math.sqrt(rq) - br
                    di = Y[i, 1] * math.sqrt(rq) - bi
                    tol_r = atol + rtol * abs(br)
                    tol_i = atol + rtol * abs(bi)

                        ok = False

                for i in range(n):
                    vec[i] = complex(vec[i].real * sn, vec[i].imag * sn)

            if have_prev:
                dred = lam_re - prev_re
                dimin = lam_im - prev_im
                if math.sqrt(dred * dred + dimin * dimin) <= 1e-13 * nrm:
                    break
            prev_re = lam_re
            prev_im = lam_im
            have_prev = True

        return False, 0.0 + 0.0j, vec

    # Compile once at import time so the first timed call is already fast.
    try:  # pragma: no cover
